args.name: SMOKE {{run}} Expertise App
args.description: Smoke application for the expert and application skills

lookup.app: SELECT id FROM applications WHERE name = 'SMOKE {{run}} Expertise App' AND business_area_id = 3
lookup.expert: SELECT member_id FROM agent_profiles WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY member_id LIMIT 1

lookup.sme_ok: SELECT 'yes' FROM applications WHERE id = {{app}} AND sme_agent_member_id = {{expert}}
lookup.reaches: SELECT 'yes' WHERE {{app}} = ANY (app_agent_skill_application_ids({{expert}})) AND NOT ({{app}} = ANY (app_member_application_ids({{expert}})))

lookup.assignment: SELECT id FROM skill_assignments WHERE application_id = {{app}} AND revoked_at IS NULL
